sahneler.metin: A B-52 bomber rolled into a steep turn over Fairchild Air Force Base.
It stalled, hit the ground, and exploded, killing all four aboard.
The crash was caught on video.
The pilot pushed the bomber beyond its limits.
Leaders didn't act on earlier incidents.
Investigators blamed his behavior and the lack of response.
It became a classic lesson in leadership failure.

aciklama:
Fairchild B-52 stalled and crashed at Fairchild Air Force Base. The cause: a low, steep turn causing a stall, after years of unchecked risky flying.
